answer: Bind the bond to a hardware root key, one device per bond, private half never leaving the enclave. Convert rewards into a vesting stream released across 100 epochs. Attach a fresh nonce to every submission so a captured transcript cannot be replayed. A hollow identity then costs a real device and a locked bond, and a cloned root raises a violet flag the moment two addresses sign at once. Trade-off: a lost device freezes the stream, and honest operators carry that risk with no pearl to show for it until the device is replaced.
